info.title: API.SH: Turo
info.description: The Turo API from API.SH: public Turo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Whether a vehicle can be booked for the dates, and the pickup and return times still open on those days.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/turo-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Turo vehicle id or vehicle link. Required unless latest=true.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true = the first vehicle of a search around lat/lng (default Los Angeles) instead of an id.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Pickup date YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days ahead, or days_ahead).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD (default 3 days after pickup).

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Pickup time HH:MM (default 10:00).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Return time HH:MM (default 10:00).

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Pickup this many days from today when start_date is not given (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cars for rent around a point for the trip dates, with make, model, vehicle type, engine (gas, hybrid, electric, diesel), transmission, minimum seats, year range, total price range, features and delivery filters, sorted by relevance, price or distance: id, link, make, model, year, type, daily price, rating, completed trips, badges, All-Star host, distance, location, image, plus the total, search radius and price histogram. One page of up to 200 vehicles (`limit`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/turo-search

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the pickup area.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the pickup area.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country of the search.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Pickup date YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days ahead, or days_ahead).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD (default 3 days after pickup).

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Pickup time HH:MM (default 10:00).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Return time HH:MM (default 10:00).

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Pickup this many days from today when start_date is not given (default 30).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Makes, comma-separated (e.g. Tesla).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Models, comma-separated (with make, e.g. Model 3).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Vehicle types, comma-separated: CAR, SUV, MINIVAN, TRUCK, VAN, CARGO_VAN, BOX_TRUCK, COUPE, SEDAN, CONVERTIBLE, HATCHBACK_WAGON, COMPACT_SUV, MIDSIZE_SUV, FULLSIZE_SUV.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Engines, comma-separated: GAS, HYBRID, ELECTRIC, DIESEL.

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description: manual or automatic.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Feature codes, comma-separated (e.g. APPLE_CARPLAY, ANDROID_AUTO, BACKUP_CAMERA, AWD).

parameters.name: min_seats
parameters.description: Minimum number of seats.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Oldest model year.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Newest model year.

parameters.name: min_total_price
parameters.description: Minimum trip total before taxes (USD).

parameters.name: max_total_price
parameters.description: Maximum trip total before taxes (USD).

parameters.name: pickup
parameters.description: all (default), delivery (delivered to the point) or nearby.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Vehicles to return (max 200, default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One vehicle's listing: make, model, year, trim, type, colour, description and guidelines, specs (seats, doors, fuel, MPG, battery range, transmission), features, rates and discounts, extras with prices, approximate location, airports served, minimum age, trips, reviews, favourites, rating breakdown, photos, protection plan and the host (first name, All-Star status). Unlisted vehicles answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/turo-vehicle

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
